definitions.explanation: The central or innermost portion of a geographical area, city, object, or region. Often used of the downtown core of a city, the inner zone of a typhoon, or the central part of a body or structure.

examples.japanese: {都市|とし}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}。
examples.english: The downtown area of the city.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}が{上陸|じょうりく}した。
examples.english: The center of the typhoon made landfall.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}は{家賃|やちん}が{非常|ひじょう}に{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Rent is extremely high in the central areas of Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}の{被害|ひがい}は{市|し}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}していた。
examples.english: The earthquake damage was concentrated in the central part of the city.

notes:
Compound of {中心|ちゅうしん} ('center; middle') and the suffix {部|ぶ} ('part; section'). The {部|ぶ} suffix is productive and produces area/zone nouns such as {上部|じょうぶ} ('upper part'), {下部|かぶ} ('lower part'), and {内部|ないぶ} ('interior').

USAGE:
Refers to the central zone of something that has spatial extent — a city, a region, a storm system, an organ. Slightly more technical or formal than plain {中心|ちゅうしん}, which can mean 'center point' or 'focal person.' Often translated as 'downtown,' 'city center,' or simply 'center' depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都市|とし}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: downtown of the city
- {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}に{位置|いち}する: to be located in the center
- {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}を{通|とお}る: to pass through the central area
- {台風|たいふう}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: the center of a typhoon
- {都心|としん}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: the very heart of the city
- {街|まち}の{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: the town center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中心|ちゅうしん}: center; focus — abstract 'center'; can refer to a point or person
- {都心|としん}: urban center; downtown (specifically of a metropolis like Tokyo)
- {中央|ちゅうおう}: central; middle — emphasizes axis or national center ({中央政府|ちゅうおうせいふ})
- {中部|ちゅうぶ}: central region (of Japan) — proper geographic division
- {内部|ないぶ}: interior — inside, not necessarily central
